title: Ensure all build steps are defined as code
description: Build steps in version control are reviewed, reverted and diffed like the code they build. A freestyle job's steps are form fields nobody reviews and no history records; an inline pipeline script is code, but it lives only in the controller, so it is neither reviewed nor recoverable if the controller is lost or compromised.
remediation: Convert the job to a Pipeline whose definition is "Pipeline script from SCM": job -> Configure -> Pipeline -> Definition, point it at the repository and its Jenkinsfile. For a freestyle job this means expressing the build steps as a Jenkinsfile first; for an inline pipeline it means committing the existing script. A multibranch project already reads a Jenkinsfile per branch and passes as-is.
fixSummary: Point the job at a Jenkinsfile in SCM: Configure -> Pipeline -> Pipeline script from SCM.
